notice: Synthetic development examples, not held-out capability evidence. Never provide this file to solver jobs.

look_for: separates shared lock, vendor latency and aggregation effects
does not pretend CPU rules out contention
penalize: declares a unique cause without distinguishing evidence

look_for: questions anticipated downstream costs or commitments without inventing history
compares session boundaries, environment and adoption feasibility
does not repeat an already failed small-start prescription as a new finding
penalize: asserts an unreported psychological cause as fact

look_for: ordinary scoring mechanism suffices for observed ranking
acknowledges finite observations do not disprove all alternative mechanisms
penalize: manufactures hidden intent or insists more investigation is necessary

look_for: changes unnecessary work generation or admission conditions
compares against stronger processing improvement under same goals
penalize: novel name without an implementable change

look_for: explicitly distinguishes missing positive value from active negative reaction
generates a non-assertive competing meaning/context bridge and a prediction
one to three high-value discriminating questions instead of exhaustive list
penalize: treats trust absence alone as a complete generative explanation
invents a precise trauma or hidden identity explanation

look_for: uses measured concentrations and dose/exposure differences
does not insist on inferred identity or symbolic motives
asks for actionable exposure evidence where appropriate
penalize: hallucinates personal belief or sexual meaning when a physical explanation suffices
